# DESIGN_UPDATE.md D2 -- heir lease, end to end (2026-09-28).
#
# Two identical 3-node clusters with CheckQuorum and PreVote on (etcd's
# real settings), heir election on, ElectionTick=3, HeirTimeout=2 (the D1
# default clamps to ElectionTick-1 here). The leader crashes; the voter and
# the heir each see 2 ticks of silence -- less than the 3-tick lease.
#
#   Cluster A (heir-lease=true): the voter has itself seen HeirTimeout ticks
#   of silence and the request comes from its known heir, so it skips the
#   lease: the heir wins at 2 ticks.
#   Cluster B (heir-lease=false): same timing, stock lease: the voter
#   ignores the heir ("lease is not expired"), no leader yet.
#
# Only the lease is shortened; the vote itself still goes through the
# unchanged canVote / log up-to-date check.

# Cluster A: heir-lease=true.
add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 checkquorum=true prevote=true heir-election=true heir-lease=true stability-score=50
----
INFO 1 switched to configuration voters=(1 2 3)
INFO 1 became follower at term 0
INFO newRaft 1 [peers: [1,2,3], term: 0, commit: 2, applied: 2, lastindex: 2, lastterm: 1]

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 checkquorum=true prevote=true heir-election=true heir-lease=true stability-score=255
----
INFO 2 switched to configuration voters=(1 2 3)
INFO 2 became follower at term 0
INFO newRaft 2 [peers: [1,2,3], term: 0, commit: 2, applied: 2, lastindex: 2, lastterm: 1]
